blurb:
PLEASE CONTACT US TO BOOK GROUPS LARGER THAN 6 PARTICIPANTS

The vehicle provided for this activity will depend on the group size. It can be a 7-passenger MINIVAN or a 5-seater regular sedan.*

Embark on the ultimate adventure with our Guided Tour to Death Valley. Join our small group as we explore the awe-inspiring landscapes and hidden gems of this captivating national park. Led by a professional tour guide, you'll discover the best things to do in Death Valley while feeling safe and well taken care of.

Get ready to witness breathtaking vistas, from the otherworldly Badwater Basin to the mesmerizing Artist's Palette. Our expert guide will share fascinating insights about the park's history, geology, and unique flora and fauna along the way. With our small group format, you'll enjoy a personalized experience, making new friends who share your love for adventure.
